newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore says 1996 commerce sector grew 6.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Singapore says 1996 commerce sector grew 6.0 pct.

text.p: Singapore's commerce sector grew 6.0 percent in 1996, down from 9.0 percent in 1995, the Ministry of Trade and Industry said on Tuesday.

Slower growth was registered in most sub-sectors, with entrepot trade showing the sharpest decline, resulting from an export slowdown in the regional economies, the ministry said. -- Singapore newsroom 65-8703080
